alternatives: Reopen pin-model-010. Its locked choice says pinned repos 'form the widget and background-refresh set', but RepoWidget selects its repository from per-widget RepoWidgetConfigStore rather than pins (0 pin references), and no background-refresh set exists at all. Only StackWidget honours the pin clause.

Convert the tall row feed to live data and retire WIDGET_PREVIEW_LABEL, the prior recommendation — still valid, but it makes more fixture surface live without addressing whether live data stays current.
data.reason: Making the compact slot live converted a cosmetic fixture problem into a real staleness problem: fixtures regenerated at render time and were always current, whereas a stored snapshot ages with nothing to refresh it and nothing on screen to disclose its age.
data.recommended: Grill widget freshness: give the compact widget a background refresh path and a visible freshness signal. Evidence: updatePeriodMillis=0 on both widget XMLs, no WorkManager/AlarmManager/JobScheduler anywhere and no such dependency declared, and WidgetRefresh.updateAll reachable only from MainActivity (pin/scenario change) and RepoGlanceViewModel (repo opened in app). A compact widget's counts are therefore frozen at the last in-app visit to that repo, and the locked round-2 ledger composition surfaces neither observedAt age nor the LAST_GOOD basis, so an arbitrarily old count renders as a bare number.
